adql: SELECT obs_id, dp_id, em_min, em_max, t_min, t_max, t_exptime FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE obs_collection='VIDEO' AND dataproduct_subtype='pawprint' AND 1=INTERSECTS(s_region, POINT('ICRS',53.1886698330,-27.8125394028)) ORDER BY t_min, dp_id
scope: Published pawprint polygons contain the exact query point. Per-epoch pixel masks, usable exposure and sensitivity require image-level checks. Overlapping pawprints can belong to the same observing block. The finite H-band aperture pilot subtracts a local annulus and uses signed, control-centered photometry. Its spatial scatter omits aperture correction, per-pixel confidence maps and between-epoch PSF matching. It measures sensitivity, not variability.
